Project: C:\Users\pc\.cursor\projects\empty-window

## User request (French)
1. **Remove dropdown menus** in Admin — user wants to **just scroll** instead of selects/dropdowns
2. Admin creation forms should take **entire page**, not phone-narrow layout on PC

## Implementation

### Remove dropdowns → scrollable alternatives
In `src/pages/Admin.tsx` replace `<select>` elements with:
- **Category** (for tasks): horizontal scrollable chip/list of all categories, or vertical scrollable list of category cards — tap to select (highlight selected)
- **Level**: already chips? keep/enhance as horizontal scroll row
- **Frequency**: keep radio buttons (not dropdown)
- **Reward type / punishment trigger**: radios not selects
- **Users role**: toggle chips User | Admin instead of select
- Any other `<select>` in Admin → scrollable chip/pill lists or radio groups

### Full page layout (not phone column)
- Admin page: single column **vertical scroll** for entire content OR full-width stacked sections
- Remove narrow two-column phone feel on desktop — user wants forms to use **full viewport width**
- At 1024px+: each tab content spans `width: 100%`, padding 1.5–2rem, forms use CSS grid `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr))` for fields
- List + form: consider **stacked full-width** (list section full width, then form section full width below) instead of narrow side-by-side phone columns — OR side-by-side but each column uses 50% of full screen not 30rem
- Ensure `.app-shell--admin-full` removes ALL max-width caps on admin main content
- Creation forms: `max-width: none` on admin forms

### Navigation tabs
- Keep sticky tab bar (Categories | Tasks | etc.) — those are NOT "dropdowns"
- Tab panels: one scrollable page per tab, all controls visible via scroll

### UX
- English strings
- Touch-friendly chip selection
- Preserve CRUD logic, resolvedCategoryId fix, sticky admin chrome

Return files changed and what replaced each dropdown.
</user_query>

input.final_summary: Admin no longer uses any `<select>` elements. Category, level, frequency, reward type, punishment trigger, and user role are all chip or radio controls with horizontal scroll where needed. At 1024px+ the admin layout stacks list and form full-width, and form fields use a responsive CSS grid.

content.text:
## Files changed

1. **`src/pages/Admin.tsx`**
2. **`src/index.css`**

## Dropdowns removed (3 `<select>` → scroll/chips)

| Location | Was | Now |
|----------|-----|-----|
| **Tasks list filter** | `<select>` (All categories + options) | `CategoryChips` — horizontal scroll row with **All categories** + category pills |
| **Tasks form — Category** | `<select>` bound to `resolvedCategoryId` | `CategoryChips` — scrollable pills; tap to set `categoryId` (keeps `resolvedCategoryId` on submit) |
| **Users form — Role** | `<select>` User / Admin | `ChipSelect` toggle chips **User \| Admin** |

**Already non-dropdown (unchanged):** Level (`ChipSelect`, now `scroll`), Frequency (`RadioRow`), Reward type / badge unlock (`RadioRow`), Punishment trigger (`RadioRow`).

## Layout (desktop full page)

- **1024px+** under `.app-shell--admin-full`: list and form **stack full width** (no 32rem form cap).
- Form groups use `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr))`.
- `.admin-form-card`: `max-width: none; width: 100%`.
- Sticky tab bar and `resolvedCategoryId` validation unchanged.

## New UI pieces

- `CategoryChips` — scrollable category pills with icon, name, and color accent.
- `admin-chips--scroll`, `admin-category-chip*` CSS for touch-friendly horizontal scroll.

**Build:** `npm run build` passes; no `<select>` left in `Admin.tsx`.
